relations.subject: Robert Francis Harper
relations.evidence: ROBERT FRANCIS HARPER, Ph. D., LL. D., Professor of Semitic Languages in the University of Chicago, and author of many books on Assyrian and Babylonian literature, died in London, August 6, 1914.

relations.subject: Christopher Johnston
relations.role: Professor of Oriental History and Archeology
relations.evidence: CHRISTOPHER JOHNSTON, M. D., Ph. D., LL. D., Professor of Oriental History and Archeology in Johns Hopkins University, died in Baltimore, June 26, 1914.

relations.subject: Winfred Robert Martin
relations.evidence: WINFRED ROBERT MARTIN, Ph. D., LL. D., recently Librarian of the Hispanic Society of America, died February 21, 1915, in New York.

relations.subject: Winfred Robert Martin
relations.evidence: Dr. Martin, who was a man of wide knowledge and varied attainments, was for some years Professor of Oriental Languages at Trinity College.
